meta.title: Traffic Light: vendors see a colour status only
gaps: Verify the traffic-light status through its rendered Green/Amber/Red colour rather than textual content or CSS.
Verify that competitor prices are hidden while allowing the vendor's own price-entry field.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the traffic-light status through its rendered Green/Amber/Red colour rather than textual content or CSS.; Verify that competitor prices are hidden while allowing the vendor's own price-entry field.

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for traffic-light auction configuration.
Configure a traffic-light auction with a defined bid range.
Set the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add one product for the vendor to bid on.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will place the bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the traffic-light auction's vendor bidding screen.
Submit a bid inside the configured range to trigger the expected traffic-light status.
Check that the vendor screen exposes the expected green status text for the in-range bid.
Check that the vendor screen does not expose a rank indicator.
